species.name: Trout
why: Water 58°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 26–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 58°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 32–56 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–32 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 58°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–20 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
